# Three sinks of one service: the service name tells them apart only
# with the sink name beside it (`languages/ci/nix:V53`).
systemd.services.backup.preStart | backup-pre-start | {host_dir}/{host_stem}
systemd.services.backup.script | backup-script | {host_dir}/{host_stem}
systemd.services.backup.postStart | backup-post-start | {host_dir}/{host_stem}
